candidateTechnique: Preserve a recognizable subject through a reveal and leave the new state enough room to read
instruction: Give the editor only the brief and assets. Keep the evaluation key out of its context.

cases.brief: Vídeo vertical de uma luminária de leitura fictícia. Mostre a luminária sendo acesa e a página se tornando legível. Termine com Conheça a luminária.
materialRequirements: Same real lamp and book before and after the action
One continuous source with the switch gesture
evaluationKey: A viewer can identify the same lamp before and after
The switch and consequence remain legible
Any lighting transition serves the action and preserves the page detail

cases.brief: Demonstre como exportar um projeto na Clicko usando uma gravação real da interface. Mostre o comando e a confirmação.
materialRequirements: Authorized interface capture with both action and confirmation
evaluationKey: The cursor and relevant control remain visible
No decorative wipe hides the confirmation
The method can be explained from the final edit
An effect is optional and must not obscure the action

promotionRequires: Record retrieved evidence and applied decisions
No material regression in factual accuracy, legibility or required sound
A successful case and an appropriate adaptation or refusal in the counterexample
